notes.title: Shadowhand Solitaire - Multi-Language Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/afa193882a6afa3257d6f6d873514bf160ed77f3.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now change language for Shadowhand Solitaire on Steam via the options screen. [/p][p]Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][p]Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.[/p][p]Enjoy playing Shadowhand Solitaire in your chosen language![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
